name: Judgment

components.pose: She stands on broad stone steps with her weapon held low in one hand, its point near the ground, the other hand raised flat as if halting someone below, wings arched back, an unyielding, level gaze to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A hard, cold light falls from above onto the steps and swirling frost, snowflakes and ice crystals gather heavily at her feet, {{MAGIC}} light along the edge of her weapon.

notes: DUTY: Judgment, for her alignment (rank 7); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
